 The Weeknd , After Hours Til Dawn The Weeknd plays Kuala Lumpur on 5 November at TM Stadium Nasional
 Published on 11/01/2026 at 11:45 | Editorial responsibility: Rafael Müller, Editor-in-Chief AD HOC NEWS 
 The Weeknd brings the After Hours Til Dawn tour to Kuala Lumpur on 5 November 2026, with TM Stadium Nasional hosting the Asia leg’s grand finale. 
 The Weeknd, After Hours Til Dawn, Kuala Lumpur, TM Stadium Nasional, R&B, pop, music, concert, Malaysia, Live Nation Malaysia, Illustration mit AI erstellt. 
 The Weeknd brings the After Hours Til Dawn concert to TM Stadium Nasional in Kuala Lumpur on 5 November 2026. The official schedule also lists another performance at the same venue on 4 November 2026.
 The Weeknd brings After Hours Til Dawn to Kuala Lumpur
 An official tour listing names The Weeknd at TM Stadium Nasional for both Kuala Lumpur dates, 4 November 2026 and 5 November 2026. The entries identify the Malaysian capital and the venue for each concert.
 The concert carries the After Hours Til Dawn name, linking the Kuala Lumpur engagement to the current stadium run. Malay Mail names Live Nation Malaysia as organiser and describes 5 November 2026 as the added date. The publication also calls the concert the grand finale of the Asia leg.
 The Weeknd’s R&B catalogue frames the stadium show
 Born and raised in Toronto, The Weeknd is a Canadian singer-songwriter associated with R&B and pop. Britannica describes his music as atmospheric rhythm and blues shaped by a distinctive falsetto.
 The tour’s published album focus includes After Hours , Dawn FM and Hurry Up Tomorrow , connecting the Kuala Lumpur concerts with the central records of his recent live programme. The sequence also places the show within a catalogue that includes House of Balloons , Trilogy and Starboy .
 The Kuala Lumpur engagement brings those album references into a single stadium setting under the After Hours Til Dawn title. It also extends a performance format that combines R&B songwriting with pop production and electronic textures.
 The Weeknd’s Kuala Lumpur dates carry the Asia finale
 The two Kuala Lumpur concerts are consecutive, with 4 November 2026 preceding the 5 November 2026 finale. The official schedule places 5 November 2026 after the 4 November date at TM Stadium Nasional.
 The venue is in Bukit Jalil, within Kuala Lumpur, and is also known as Bukit Jalil National Stadium. Together, the two entries give the Malaysian capital a pair of dates under the same tour name.
 The Weeknd: what fans in Germany need to know
 5 November 2026: The Weeknd plays TM Stadium Nasional in Kuala Lumpur as the After Hours Til Dawn tour reaches its Asia finale.
 4 November 2026: The Weeknd plays the preceding Kuala Lumpur date at TM Stadium Nasional.
 Tour: After Hours Til Dawn ; organiser: Live Nation Malaysia.
